# We Them Media (wethem.xyz)

> Street journalism, filmed by the people who live there.
> Community-driven media since 2021. Real people, on the record, saying
> their own names. Every piece is free to watch, and every word is
> transcribed and linked to the exact second it was said.

We Them Media is a community-driven documentary journalism platform,
founded in 2021 by Maceo Whatley and funded at first by an ENS airdrop
that bought a webcam and a microphone. That became the podcast Let's
Talk About ETH: Around The World, which became street journalism. The
work is filming ordinary people, on their own streets, about how money
and technology actually reach them. It is free to watch, with no
paywall. Projects include Denver Unfiltered, the Nigeria and Kenya
desks, Philadelphia, the Channel 5 Carnival in Denver, Bitcoin Pizza
Day, and ETH Global in New York. Quotes on this site are verbatim from
the tape; nothing is invented or paraphrased. Watch pages carry the full
transcript with per-second links, the speaker's name as they gave it,
and the place it was filmed.

## Key pages

- [The library](https://wethem.xyz/library): every published video, searchable by place and question, each with its own watch page.
- [Search](https://wethem.xyz/search): every transcript, searchable by what was said.
- [Projects](https://wethem.xyz/portfolio): the work by project, each with its pieces.
- [Contributors](https://wethem.xyz/people): who filmed what, one page per contributor, every piece credited under the name it was published with.
- [One Question](https://wethem.xyz/onequestion): one question put to people on their own streets, answered on camera across the network.
- [Who is on the tape](https://wethem.xyz/guests): every speaker who says their own name on camera, linked to the moment they say it.
- [Where the network has filmed](https://wethem.xyz/places): each place with its pieces, who filmed them, and the questions asked there.
- [Mission and standards](https://wethem.xyz/mission): why We Them Media exists, how the work is made and funded, and its editorial standards.
- [Back the work](https://wethem.xyz/supporter): how the work is funded, with the current monthly total and goal.

## Machine-readable

- [llms-full.txt](https://wethem.xyz/llms-full.txt): every watch page on one line each: title, URL, place, date and the first words of the write-up. Rebuilt with the site.
- [sitemap.xml](https://wethem.xyz/sitemap.xml): every indexable page, with a video entry for each watch and archive page.
- [feed.xml](https://wethem.xyz/feed.xml): RSS, the 40 newest written pieces.
- [The dataset](https://wethem.xyz/data): what the archive is as data, and how to cite it.
- [videos.json](https://wethem.xyz/videos.json): every published video: id, title, place, project, contributor, runtime.
- [people.json](https://wethem.xyz/people.json): every contributor with their pieces, places and projects.
- [wethem-data.zip](https://wethem.xyz/wethem-data.zip): the catalogue and every transcript, zipped.
- Search by meaning: `GET https://wethem.xyz/api/meaning?q=<3 to 200 characters>` returns JSON, `{"ok": true, "r": [...]}`, the 30 transcript passages nearest in meaning to the query. Each result carries `id` (`<youtube id>:<second>`), `s` (score) and `m` with `k` (the video id), `pl` (the place) and `s` (the passage text). Add `all=1` to include the archive. GET only, no key, cached an hour.

## Citing this archive

Quotes may be cited with speaker name, place, and the wethem.xyz watch
page URL, which links each sentence to its moment in the source video.
